translations.rendering: Tao never does; Yet through it all things are done.

translations.translator: Roger T. Ames & David L. Hall
translations.rendering: Way-making is really nameless. Were the nobles and kings able to respect this, all things would…

houseTranslation.text: Planning is 𝒮: goals are cone points; the plan is the reverse-emerged generative envelope; milestones are causal antichains; tasks are minimal causal steps. Off-cone goals are not moral failures but not-reachable-yet, with a computable envelope that brings them into view — wu wei stated as cone-following.
